notes.title: Try the Demo at Steam Next Fest in February!
notes.content:
I am excited to announce that the demo for 'The Whistle' will be available during Steam Next Fest in February.

In the demo, you will experience some of the early stages of the game. Ιmmerse yourself in the chaos of Harmony Hus Lake in a cabin forest where terror takes over. We invite you to be one of the first to experience it, and the demo will continue to be accessible even after the end of the festival.

notes.title: Demo Fixed
notes.content:
Hello everyone! From today you can play the demo version of The Whistle normally. if it doesn't let you try to delete it and download it again, thank you very much and sorry for the upset!

- Psycho

notes.title: The Whistle Demo Release
notes.content:
The Whistle Demo Release

Hey everyone!

I am excited to announce that the demo version of The Whistle is finally here!
I can’t thank you enough for your support and i hope you will love the demo as much as i do. If you come across any bugs or have feedback to share, please don’t hesitate to reach out. I value your input!

Please keep in mind that the demo is just a glimpse of what’s to come and does not represent the quality of the final version. The final version will be even more haunting and immersive! I can’t wait for you to experience it in full.


- Psycho

notes.title: The Whistle Announcement
notes.content:
Hello everyone and welcome to the store page!

I would like to introduce my next horror game, The Whistle.

None of this would have been possible without your support. I want to thank you for supporting my previous game.

You will be able to test out a demo of the game in a week from now. Please let me know your thoughts and feedback, as well as any bugs you discover. Please be aware that the demo does not represent the final product's quality.

I hope you enjoy the teaser trailer and the demo!

The game is currently in development and more information will be provided as the release date approaches.


-Psycho
